Name: Sign Venue Contract
Description: Get the venue contract through legal review and signed by the end of next week. Confirm that the AV package includes recording in all three rooms. Ensure all details are documented.

Name: Secure Additional Speakers
Description: Send final follow-ups to the two potential speakers with a decision deadline of Friday. If needed, use the backup list to fill any remaining slots. Lock in the speaker lineup within two weeks.

Name: Obtain Keynote Abstract
Description: Contact Dr. Osei to acquire the keynote abstract within this week. This is needed for both the website and the printed program.

Name: Launch Email Campaign
Description: Draft and prepare three email campaign waves: 1) Agenda announcement when the lineup is finalized, 2) Early-bird deadline reminder two weeks before the price change, and 3) Final-week registration push. Send the first wave the day the agenda goes live.

Name: Update Website with Speaker Pages
Description: Once the speaker lineup is locked, hand off the speaker biographies and headshots to Diego for immediate update on the landing page. Ensure this is done the same day.

Name: Approve and Order Swag
Description: Review and approve the design proofs for the swag this week. Once approved, place the order for 800 shirts, 500 notebooks, and 1,000 stickers to ensure timely delivery.
